data.title: Entero Healthcare Subsidiary Pays GST Penalty Under Protest, Plans Refund Claim
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited ( (IN:ENTERO) ).

Entero Healthcare Solutions has disclosed that its subsidiary, ACE Cardiopathy Solutions, has been hit with a Goods and Services Tax penalty by the Uttar Pradesh GST Authority for non-generation of an e-invoice. The authority levied a monetary penalty of Rs. 12,91,728, which the subsidiary has paid under protest to secure immediate release of a vehicle and prevent further demurrage charges and operational losses.

The company emphasized that the penalty amount is not material to its consolidated financial position or overall operations, limiting the financial impact for shareholders. ACE Cardiopathy plans to seek recovery or refund of the penalty through available remedies under GST law, indicating that the issue is being treated as a compliance dispute rather than a structural business risk for Entero’s wider healthcare operations.

data.title: Capgemini to Divest U.S. Federal Unit in Strategic Portfolio Shift
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Capgemini SE ( (FR:CAP) ).

Capgemini has signed a definitive agreement to sell Capgemini Government Solutions, its U.S. federal government-focused subsidiary, to ITC Federal, a digital services provider to homeland security and defense agencies. The deal, subject to customary closing conditions and expected to complete in the coming weeks, affects a relatively small unit that represented 0.4% of group revenue in 2025 and less than 2% of U.S. revenue, indicating a targeted portfolio streamlining with limited direct financial impact but a clearer strategic focus on core transformation and AI-driven services.

By divesting its specialized U.S. federal government arm, Capgemini is refining its U.S. and global footprint to emphasize higher-scale commercial and digital transformation work. The move aligns with the group’s broader positioning around AI-enabled business transformation and suggests management is concentrating resources on segments with greater growth and margin potential, while ITC Federal expands its role as a provider of digital solutions to critical federal agencies.

data.title: Grasim Reports Customs Search at Fibre Unit, Says No Material Impact
data.description:
Grasim Industries Ltd. ( (IN:GRASIM) ) has issued an update.

Grasim Industries has disclosed that customs authorities in Indore conducted a search at its cellulosic staple fibre manufacturing unit in Nagda under Section 105 of the Customs Act. The search, focused on import‑export records, began on September 11 and concluded on September 12, with the company fully cooperating and providing documentation and official statements.

The company stated that no show‑cause notice or order has been issued so far and that the enquiry relates primarily to trade transactions rather than any confirmed violation. Grasim emphasized that the action has no material impact on its financials or operations and that business activities continue as usual, aiming to reassure investors and other stakeholders about operational continuity and regulatory compliance.
